A `_headers` as `@ascribed/astro` writes one, and the `_ascribe/pages.json` of the build it was written for, for the rules a real build may not exercise: `docs/hidden/` is `unlisted`, so its Markdown version says `noindex`, as a docs page marked `listing: unlisted` would, and `docs/quoted/` is `unquoted`, so its says `nosnippet`. Its site is `https://example.com`. test/headers.test.ts reads it.
